data.description: Categories in fill order: { key, label, value, color? }. The first fills from the bottom-left corner, column by column. Shares come from the total.

label.description: What the whole is, such as "Electricity generation, 2023". Names the chart, the summary, and the table.

unit.description: Unit after raw values in the tooltip and table, such as "TWh".

formatValue.description: Formats raw values. Shares are always percentages.

rows.description: Grid rows. rows × columns cells make the whole.

columns.description: Grid columns. 10 × 10 means one cell per percent.

accentKey.description: The category painted in the first series hue, derived from the accent. The next three take the supporting series and later ones fall back to neutral steps.

activeKey.description: Controlled focused category. Other cells dim while one is focused.

onActiveChange.description: Called when a legend item is pinned or released.

legend.description: Category list with rolling shares. It sits beside the grid from 420px and below it on narrower containers.

emptyLabel.description: Message when the data is empty or sums to zero.
